text: Client emailed: can you resend the onboarding checklist? We have a template for this.
Remember to ping Contoso about the pilot results on Thursday.
Still no answer from the supplier on the revised delivery date.
Enterprise customer wants us to cap their annual price increase at 3% in the renewal.
CDN cache hit ratio dropped slightly overnight; page loads look normal.
Subscription was billed after the customer cancelled last week. They want their money back.
Login API is returning 500s for every request; customers cannot sign in. Reboot the auth nodes.
Marketing asks that we give the agency editor permissions on the corporate social accounts.
The partnership announcement is drafted and ready to go out on the website.
Can't start the data import until the customer sends us the CSV export.
Queue depth on the order worker has been creeping up for two days but orders are processing on time.
Set up a check-in with the Hooli champion in two weeks to see if adoption improved.
User asks whether we support SSO with Okta. The answer is in the approved FAQ.
Prospect will sign today if we extend the free trial by 60 days and drop the setup fee.
Awaiting the security questionnaire from the customer's procurement team.
Let the customer know the bug fix for their export issue has been deployed.
Long-time customer asks for a refund on a non-refundable annual plan. Policy says no; it's a judgment call.
A few users report slow search results, but response times are within SLA.
Quarterly compliance attestation is due on the 15th of next month.
The customer responded and wants to know the status of ticket 8812.
Memory usage on the cache cluster is higher than usual after the upgrade. Nothing is failing.
Integration is paused until the partner provides new API credentials.
Post the holiday closure notice on the website later this month.

Account manager wants to offer a partner a 20% reseller margin instead of the standard 15%.
Support contractor asked for read access to the customer PII table.
Send the executive team an update on the Q3 incident review outcomes.
Contract renewal is pending signature from the customer's CFO.
SSL certificate for the docs site expires in 45 days; auto-renew is configured.
A reseller is asking for our standard W-9 and banking letter. Both are pre-approved documents.
Customer was overcharged for 3 extra seats last month and has asked for reimbursement.
Warehouse integration has failed for 40 minutes; orders are not shipping. Failover to the secondary region.
Kick-off meeting reminder for the Umbrella project should go out the day before, next Wednesday.
Waiting for the bank to confirm the wire transfer before releasing the order.
Promote the intern to admin role in the billing system so they can run reports.
Minor uptick in failed webhook deliveries from one customer's endpoint; retries are succeeding.
Customer is asking for a copy of our data processing agreement.
The customer wants to switch from monthly to annual billing mid-term with a prorated credit. Not covered by our billing process.
Publish the incident postmortem for last Tuesday's outage on the status blog.
Vendor security review is scheduled for next quarter; nothing to do until then.
